settingsLink.title: Record types and workflows
settingsLink.subtitle: Design the fields, forms and approval flows your organisation uses for its records.

list.title: Record types and workflows
list.subtitle: Decide what each kind of record captures and the steps it goes through, from registration to closure.
list.explainPrompt: Explain how record types and workflows work in CoreFlow: what a record type is, what a workflow is, how versions work and how approvals and SLAs fit in. Keep it short and practical.

designer.notFound: This record type no longer exists, or you can't see it.
designer.askPrompt: I am designing the record type “{{ name }}” with these fields: {{ fields }}. Review it: are any fields missing for good compliance practice, and is anything unclear? Answer in short bullet points.
designer.name: Name
designer.active: Active (people can create records of this type)
designer.keyInvalid: The key must start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

designer.olderHint: This type is pinned to an older workflow version. Choose the workflow again to move new records to its latest version.

designer.publishHint: Publishing creates a new version. Existing records keep the version they were created with.

designer.blockFieldIssues: Fix the problems marked on the fields.

designer.draftLoaded: The assistant drafted this record type from your description. Review every field and step before you create it.
designer.draftAppliedToast: The draft is loaded. Review it before you publish.
designer.viewingOld: You are viewing version {{ version }}. Older versions are read-only.
designer.deleteMessage: “{{ name }}” is removed from the designer. Records created with it keep their data and history.

workflow.publishHint: Publishing creates a new version. Records already running keep the version they started on.
workflow.publishedToast: A new version of “{{ name }}” is published.
workflow.unused: No record type uses this workflow yet.
workflow.deleteMessage: “{{ name }}” is removed. A workflow that a record type still uses can't be deleted.

transitions.sod: The requester can't approve their own request

ai.title: Describe your process
ai.subtitle: Write how the process works today. The assistant proposes fields and a workflow that you then review and adjust.
ai.placeholder: For example: anyone can report a customer complaint. The quality manager assesses it within two days, assigns an owner and decides whether corrective action is needed. Closing needs the quality manager's approval.
ai.reviewNote: Nothing is saved until you review the draft and publish it.
